card.line: Thessalonica was a large Macedonian city with a Jewish synagogue, where Paul preached about Jesus, a church began, and trouble from opponents soon followed.

moments.title: Paul reasons in the synagogue
moments.text: On three Sabbaths Paul reasoned from the Scriptures that the Christ had to suffer and rise from the dead. Some Jews, many God-fearing Greeks, and quite a few leading women joined Paul and Silas.

moments.title: Uproar over Jason's house
moments.text: Jealous Jews formed a mob and sent the city into an uproar. They raided Jason's house looking for Paul and Silas, then dragged Jason and other brothers before the city officials.

moments.title: Trouble follows to Berea
moments.text: The Bereans eagerly examined the Scriptures, but Jews from Thessalonica came to Berea to stir up the crowds. The brothers sent Paul to the coast.

moments.title: Gifts for Paul's needs
moments.text: Paul told the Philippians that while he was in Thessalonica, they provided for his needs again and again.

moments.title: Demas goes to Thessalonica
moments.text: Paul wrote that Demas, in his love of this world, had deserted him and gone to Thessalonica.
